scope: Exact token-reward, capital-provider, and stakeholder report projections plus the private governance assignment-proposal response contract

checks.ruff: passed on all changed source and test files
checks.python_compile: passed on all changed source and test files

contracts.token_rewards: Selects the exact ordered 16-column distribution view and 15-column calibration view. Location bindings, date ordering, serialized distribution dates, totals, and report payload are preserved.
contracts.capital_provider_utility: Selects the exact ordered 16-column public summary view while preserving location filtering, utility ordering, scenario rows, and output metadata.
contracts.stakeholder_representation: Selects the exact ordered 8-column public representation view and 10-column equity-distribution view, preserving network scope, ordering, shared rows, distribution data, and report counts.
contracts.governance_assignment_proposals: Publishes and enforces the exact private assignment-proposal page schema, allowed item fields, location and page bounds, aware timestamps, unique descending assignment IDs, input-cursor exclusion, and full-page continuation matching. limitations: The checks use synthetic/mock data. They do not establish populated-data parity, content-level privacy, live OIDC, database behavior, tenant isolation, or production acceptance.
